mig21_mf.supports: MiG-21MF has four wing hardpoints and four R-3S, R-3R or R-60 missiles. This does not establish R-60M as an exact variant.

f16_block70.publisher: US Government Publishing Office / Department of Defense
f16_block70.supports: Opening continuation of arms-sales notification 2024-24122 describes Jordan F-16C/D Block 70, APG-83, Sniper and GBU-10 kits. It establishes aircraft-level compatibility, not a per-station clearance matrix.

f86f.supports: F-86F-35 photo caption names a pair of 1000-pound or smaller bombs and eight HVAR rockets. Exact source model block is not specified in the game.

p51d.supports: P-51D maximum load 2000 pounds of bombs or ten five-inch rockets. This is a total aircraft limit, not evidence every mixed arrangement is valid.

f4u1d.publisher: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum
f4u1d.supports: F4U-1D operational narrative includes carriage of two 1000-pound bombs. Adding smaller AN-M64 on existing bomb stations is a game fit inference from already modelled AN-M65 capability.

mirage5.supports: Mirage 5 derivative was designed for tactical support; more external load attachments and up to fourteen bombs. Page explicitly discusses 50 French Mirage 5F aircraft. It does not identify the precise bomb mark or station chart.

mig29a.publisher: National Museum of the US Air Force
mig29a.supports: Early MiG-29A six air-to-air missiles, bombs and 57mm, 80mm, 240mm rockets. This supports existing UB-16, B-8M1 and S-24B resource classes; exact station placement remains a game fit inference.

f104g.supports: Confirms F-104G multirole fighter-bomber subtype. No exact weapons or station clearance table on this page, so it is not used to authorize extra stores.

a10c.supports: A-10 Precision Engagement upgrade basis; prior package uses source hash and A-10C model identity guards before exposing targeting pods.

mirage5_actual_samp250.supports: Contemporaneous September1990 photograph and author caption identify a French Mirage5F with SAMP250kg bombs. Exact subtype/dimensions are not established.
